decision.reason: 12 October Register original article based on new 66-page London Assembly Transport Committee report: concerns TfL permit control, wheelchair access, emergency safety and unoccupied vehicle mileage. Recommendations not binding rules; Waymo/Wayve/Baidu future launches not yet permitted by a new regime. City/consultants need document pilot-operator evidence against report recommendations, but no automatic safety certification.

opportunities.target_customer: Municipal transport-policy assessment teams and mobility consultants
opportunities.core_job: Evaluate stated robotaxi pilot claims for safety incident reporting, access, empty-mileage and emergency support against local policy recommendations
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-uploaded pilot operator report CSV, permit terms, accessible vehicle count, empty mileage, incident case files and recommendation clause IDs. Rule-based missing-evidence matrix and human signoff; no vehicle data API or permit decision
